description: This file defines the ValidateController class responsible for handling user login validation within the OrangeHRM authentication system. It processes login requests, validates CSRF tokens, authenticates user credentials, manages sessions, and redirects users accordingly.

classes.name: ValidateController
classes.description: Controller handling the validation of login credentials, including CSRF token validation, user authentication, session management, and redirection within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getHomePageService
methods.description: Retrieves the HomePageService instance, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: getLoginService
methods.description: Retrieves the LoginService instance, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the login request, validating credentials and CSRF tokens, performing authentication, managing session and login state, and redirecting accordingly.
